question: What other sacred structures can be sites of ominous signs?
premises: Sacred complexes include idols and pedestals.
They also include mounts and offering pedestals.
Ominous signs can occur in such places.
inference: Ominous signs may appear at the idol, pedestal, bull mount, its abode, or the offering pedestal.
plain_english: Or they may appear at the idol, on the pedestal, on the bull and so forth, in that abode, or on the offering pedestal.
